_comment: Bundles the headless harness cannot yet drive, and WHY. These are harness limitations, not game bugs — each one plays fine in the studio and on device. They are listed here so `--all` stays usable as a CI gate without quietly forgetting them. The real fix is replacing the regex DOM shim in runner.mjs with a proper DOM (linkedom or happy-dom); every entry here should disappear when that lands.
summit: Two-step card selection: click a card to set local `selCard`, then Climb. The shim resolves compound selectors ('.hand i.sel') by their last part only, so the game's selection classes don't round-trip.
tapas: Same shape as summit — pick a card into local state, then confirm.
fishbowl: Reaches turnReady with its bot, then needs the giver's own timed guess loop; the shim's element identity isn't stable enough across re-renders for the giver's controls to stay wired.
